_comment: PROPOSED destination acceptance configuration — NOT ACTIVATED, NOT DEPLOYED.
This is the HOTEL-ECHO side, not the producer's. It would live on the destination host
at ~/.config/eanhl/backup-accept.json (mode 600). Nothing in this repository reads it
automatically, and no timer, unit or entry point exists for it yet.
There are no defaults: every key below is required, and a missing key is a hard error.
The inbox is the ONLY directory the transport key may write. work, archive, receipts,
quarantine and the lock file must all be outside it — that separation is validated here,
but the filesystem ownership and permissions that make it real still need deployment
